changes: Selected image files are proactively copied into stable in-memory File/Blob objects from arrayBuffer data, with byte-count and PNG/JPEG signature checks.
Fatal processing-error cards expose retry, replace-image, and explicit delete actions; delete is limited to processing-error cards.
Unexpected batch aborts retain every not-yet-processed image as an error card instead of silently dropping it.
Result cards no longer show the source filename; the image viewer retains the filename in its header.
The source-image button uses a refined inline SVG image icon and updated premium styling.

validation.legacyCurrentRegressions: passed after updating superseded UI assertions
